units.source_text: 言外之意是盼望日光照临，即盼望冷泉帝行幸到此也。

en.t: The unspoken meaning was that he hoped the sunlight would shine upon the place, that is, he hoped Emperor Reizei would come here on an imperial visit.

units.source_text: 钦差去后，源氏内大臣于席上闲吟古歌：“我乡名桂里，桂是蟾宫生。

en.t: After the imperial envoy had left, Genji, the Inner Minister, casually recited an old poem at the gathering: "My home is called the village of katsura; the katsura tree grows in the palace of the moon.

units.source_text: 为此盼明月，惠然来照临。”

en.t: For this reason I long for the bright moon, and hope it will graciously come and shine on us."

units.source_text: 因此想起了淡路岛，便谈到躬恒怀疑“莫非境不同？”那曲古歌，

en.t: This brought Awaji Island to mind, and they began speaking of the old poem in which Mitsune wondered, "Could it be that the place is different?"

units.source_text: 席上便有人不胜感慨，带醉而泣。

en.t: Some people at the gathering were overcome with emotion and, being drunk, began to weep.
